title: Different connection is displayed if you disconnect from one with its details expanded
line: Disconnecting a network whose details are open now keeps that network's details open instead of opening another connection's.
explanation: The Networks list re-sorts when a connection changes state (connected ones go to the top), and the sort proxy reports this as a layout change, so the list keeps its delegates in place and only rebinds their data. The expanded state belongs to the delegate, so after disconnecting the expanded Wi-Fi, the VPN that moved into its row inherited the expanded details. The list now remembers which connections (by connection path, or SSID for unsaved networks) are expanded, and a delegate that starts showing a different connection expands or collapses to match it.

commits.message:
applet: keep expansion on the same connection when the list re-sorts

Expansion lived in the list delegate, so when a connection moved after
being disconnected or connected, the one taking its row was shown
expanded. Remember expanded connections and restore them per delegate.

BUG: 469999
